## Question 2
```{r}
data(rivers)
length(rivers)
sum(rivers)
mean(rivers)
median(rivers)
var(rivers)
sd(rivers)
min(rivers)
max(rivers)
```
```{r}
data(rivers)
river_summary <- c(
length =length(rivers),
sum = sum(rivers),
mean = mean(rivers),
median = median(rivers),
variance = var(rivers),
standard_deviation = sd(rivers),
minimum = min(rivers),
maximum = max(rivers)
)
river_summary
```
